headline: DGBAS Estimates This Year's Economic Growth at 11.05%; Commodity Exports to Exceed US$1 Trillion Next Year | Industry
summary: Taiwan's statistics agency sharply raised its forecast for this year's growth to 11.05%, citing AI-driven exports, investment and consumption. Commodity exports are projected at US$903.6 billion this year.
why: Taiwan's economy is heavily tied to global semiconductor and electronics supply chains. Its growth and export figures are closely watched by investors in Asian tech.
